name: Bit tet
summary: Bít tết is a Vietnamese steak in the French style. Vietnam Tourism’s Hanoi interview places it on Hòe Nhai.
origin: Hanoi, on Hòe Nhai, in an interview published by Vietnam Tourism.
howToEat: The interview calls it a Vietnamese version of a French beefsteak. A cut, a sauce, and a doneness were not printed.
where: Hòe Nhai. The hour is Check on arrival.
seoDescription: Bít tết in Hanoi is a Vietnamese steak in the French style, on Hòe Nhai. A cut and an hour were not printed.
